process_area.title: Lease Portfolio Risk, Residual & Yield Analytics

fields.Participants: Lease Portfolio Mgr, Finance, Risk, BI (links to VS-28), Treasury (links to VS-18)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "analyze concentration vs." (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "profile" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-519 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Risk, Residual & Yield Analytics (PA-96.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Concentration risk**: Adverse event in single segment/region impairs portfolio; mitigated by limits and diversification
System Touchpoints: - Portfolio/BI dashboards (links to VS-28); treasury/ALM (links to VS-18); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: BI (links to VS-28) compute portfolio composition: outstanding balance, # of leases, average ticket, by segment (trade/corporate/government), asset category, geography, tenor, lessor partner (W3165), lease type

Lease Portfolio Mgr/Risk analyze concentration vs. limits: top-customer concentration, single-segment, single-asset-category, single-region; flag breaches and recommend rebalancing (origination tilt, partner diversification)
Finance/Treasury (links to VS-18) report portfolio metrics to ALCO/Finance Committee (links to VS-36); mature/amortize portfolio projections; align funding to asset profile (W3181)

fields.Participants: Lease Credit Mgr, Risk, Finance, Internal Audit (links to VS-21)
fields.Trigger: Monthly risk cycle; delinquency migration; ECL re-measurement

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitor portfolio credit quality" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-post of "Finance compute Expected Credit Loss" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "methodology, collection effectiveness" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: back-testing and periodic model validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Model-risk**: Mis-calibrated scoring under-prices risk; mitigated by back-testing and periodic model validation
System Touchpoints: - Credit-scoring model; ECL engine; GL/provision (links to VS-17); audit (links to VS-21)

steps.activity: Lease Credit Mgr/Risk monitor portfolio credit quality: delinquency buckets (30/60/90+), default rate, cure rate, migration by internal rating; refresh scoring model performance vs. actuals
Finance compute Expected Credit Loss (ECL) per PFRS 9 / PAS 39 (links to VS-17): PD × LGD × EAD by bucket; post provision; report movement to Finance Committee (links to VS-36)
Internal Audit (links to VS-21) periodically audit credit process: underwriting quality, scoring accuracy, provisioning methodology, collection effectiveness; findings to audit committee

fields.Participants: Lease Portfolio Mgr, Inventory (links to VS-05), Category (links to VS-01), Quality, Sales (links to VS-11)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "track residual realization" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "report residual risk to Finance Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-519 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Risk, Residual & Yield Analytics (PA-96.3).)
- operational: conservative residual and diverse remarketing channels
Pain Points / Risks: - **Used-market-volatility risk**: Secondary-market price swings affect recovery; mitigated by conservative residual and diverse remarketing channels
System Touchpoints: - Residual master (links to W3162); inventory (links to VS-05); remarketing channel (links to VS-09/VS-11)

steps.activity: Lease Portfolio Mgr/Category (links to VS-01) track residual realization: returned-asset sale price vs. book residual; analyze by asset category, age, condition; identify over/under-stated residuals

Inventory/Sales (links to VS-11) remarket returned assets: certified-pre-owned sale (links to VS-09 W916), auction, dealer wholesale, redeploy to new lease (W3175), refurbish (links to VS-09), or scrap (links to VS-73); maximize recovery
Lease Portfolio Mgr/Risk recalibrate residual curves (W3162) based on actual realization; adjust pricing; report residual risk to Finance Committee (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Lease Portfolio Mgr, Finance, BI (links to VS-28), Treasury (links to VS-18)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "analyze per-deal IRR vs." (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report profitability to ALCO/Finance Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-519 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Risk, Residual & Yield Analytics (PA-96.3).)
- operational: risk-based pricing and operating-cost discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Yield-erosion risk**: Competitive pressure compresses margins; mitigated by risk-based pricing and operating-cost discipline
System Touchpoints: - Profitability analytics (links to VS-28/VS-17); treasury/ALM (links to VS-18); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Finance/BI (links to VS-28) compute portfolio yield: effective interest yield, net interest margin (yield − cost-of-funds), operating cost ratio, credit cost (provisions), residual gain/loss; segment by product/segment/partner
Lease Portfolio Mgr analyze per-deal IRR vs. pricing-model target; identify under-yielding deals (mis-pricing, restructuring losses, credit costs); recommend pricing/underwriting adjustments
Treasury/Finance (links to VS-18) report profitability to ALCO/Finance Committee; calibrate new-business pricing to hit target return-on-risk-adjusted-capital; feed into strategy (W3161)

fields.Participants: Treasury Mgr, CFO, Lease Portfolio Mgr, Legal, Investment Bank (if securitization)
fields.Trigger: Portfolio scale threshold; funding-cost optimization; partner-bank facility renewal

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-match of "match funding tenor/currency to lease assets" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-post of "post-trade servicing and reporting" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-519 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Risk, Residual & Yield Analytics (PA-96.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Funding-mismatch risk**: Short-term funding long-term assets; mitigated by ALM discipline and tenor-matching
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/funding (links to VS-18); GL (links to VS-17); legal/securitization documentation

steps.activity: Treasury (links to VS-18) maintain funding sources: warehouse line, partner-bank facilities, lessor funding (W3165); match funding tenor/currency to lease assets; manage interest-rate gap (fixed vs. floating)
At portfolio scale: evaluate securitization / lease-asset-backed securities (ABS) or whole-portfolio sale to free capital and reduce funding cost; engage investment bank for structuring
Finance/Legal structure transaction: asset-pool selection, credit enhancement, rating-agency process, disclosures; execute and book (links to VS-17); manage post-trade servicing and reporting

fields.Participants: Compliance Officer, Legal, Finance, Lease Operations Mgr, External Counsel

workflows.name: Lease Regulatory Compliance (BSP, Truth in Lending, BIR)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Compliance/Legal map applicable regulations" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "records per BIR" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track regulatory-change management" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: compliance calendar and external counsel review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-compliance risk**: Lapsed license/disclosure triggers penalties; mitigated by compliance calendar and external counsel review
System Touchpoints: - Compliance register; Truth-in-Lending disclosure; AML (links to VS-86); privacy (links to VS-91); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Compliance/Legal map applicable regulations: BSP rules (if BuildRight entity is financing-company-registered or partners with BSP-supervised lessor), Truth in Lending Act (RA 3765) disclosure, Consumer Act (RA 7394) for any consumer-adjacent lease, BIR lease-accounting/tax (links to VS-79), SEC reporting for financing companies

Lease Operations implement compliance: Truth-in-Lending disclosure on every quote (W3164), fair-collection-practices (no harassment — links to VS-84 for collections), data privacy (links to VS-91), anti-money-laundering on lease payments (links to VS-86), books-and-records per BIR
Compliance respond to regulatory examinations; remediate findings; track regulatory-change management (links to VS-22); report to Audit/Compliance Committee (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Tax Mgr, Finance, Lease Operations Mgr, External Tax Counsel
fields.Trigger: Billing cycle (W3170); tax filing; BIR inquiry

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "document tax positions" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "generate BIR-compliant invoice and Form 2307 for customer withholding" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "file income tax on lease profit" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-519 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Risk, Residual & Yield Analytics (PA-96.3).)
- operational: structured tax design and external counsel review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Tax-mis-classification risk**: Wrong treatment triggers BIR assessment and customer dispute; mitigated by structured tax design and external counsel review
System Touchpoints: - Tax engine (links to VS-79); e-invoicing (links to VS-79); GL (links to VS-17); audit (links to VS-21)

steps.activity: Tax Mgr structure lease taxation per lease type and BIR rules: operating lease rentals = VATable lease income; finance lease = separate treatment of principal/interest; creditable withholding tax (EWT/CWT) on rental payments by customer; document tax positions (links to VS-79)

System compute per-invoice: VAT (12%) on lease rental, EWT (5% on lease rentals per RR 2-98, withheld by the customer-lessee), any percentage tax; generate BIR-compliant invoice and Form 2307 for customer withholding (links to VS-79)
Tax Mgr remit VAT/EWT to BIR (links to VS-79); reconcile creditable withholding credits; file income tax on lease profit; defend on BIR audit (links to VS-21); issue annual tax documents to customers

fields.Participants: Lease Portfolio Mgr, Finance, BI (links to VS-28), B2B Sales (links to VS-11), Strategy (links to VS-33)

workflows.name: Lease Customer Lifetime Value & Portfolio Strategy

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-renew of "renewal rate, NPV" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-identify of "identify high-CLV segments and design portfolio-growth plays" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to executive committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-519 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Risk, Residual & Yield Analytics (PA-96.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **CLV-over-estimate risk**: Overstated CLV drives unwise acquisition spend; mitigated by conservative assumptions and back-testing
System Touchpoints: - CLV model (links to VS-28); CRM/opportunity (links to VS-11/VS-13); strategy/portfolio (links to VS-33)

steps.activity: BI/Finance (links to VS-28) compute customer lifetime value: expected revenue (lease income + cross-sell of merchandise, services, retail-media — links to VS-48), cost (funding, credit, ops), retention/renewal rate, NPV; segment by customer type

B2B Sales/Lease Portfolio Mgr identify high-CLV segments and design portfolio-growth plays: cross-sell lease to merchandise customers (links to VS-11), bundle maintenance/service (links to VS-12), offer trade-in/upgrade cycle (links to VS-09); align sales incentives
Strategy/Lease Portfolio Mgr refine portfolio strategy (W3161) based on CLV: target segments, asset categories, partner mix, pricing; report to executive committee (links to VS-33/VS-36)
